question: By whom and by what means is the yoginī named Will said to extend up to the end of Māyā?
premises: The yoginī named Will is asserted.
She is associated with the siddhas.
She extends up to the end of Māyā by supreme will.
inference: The yoginī named Will, in relation to the siddhas, extends up to the end of Māyā by supreme will.
uncertainties: The exact relation between the yoginī and the siddhas is not specified.
plain_english: The yoginī named Will, by the siddhas and by supreme will, extends up to the end of Māyā.
